Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 99.97 is moderate. SOFR measures secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.487 is the latest returned weekly observation for Oct 23, not a live reading.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • The Federal Reserve Board November calendar lists no FOMC decision this week; minutes from the Oct 27-28 meeting are scheduled Wed Nov 18 at 2:00 PM ET. The December calendar lists the Dec 8-9 meeting, with statement/decision Dec 9 at 2:00 PM and press conference at 2:30 PM ET.
  • Selected Fed statistical releases: H.15 Wed Nov 4 at 4:15 PM, H.4.1 Thu Nov 5 at 4:30 PM, and H.8 Fri Nov 6 at 4:15 PM; dates follow each release's own Board-calendar day list. Latest funding and conditions observations are lagged: SOFR 3.95% effective Nov 2, NFCI -0.487 for the week ending Oct 23, MOVE 99.97 and official 10-year Treasury close 4.95% on Nov 3.
  • These rates and conditions measures provide context, not live funding or yield quotes. No FOMC action or policy decision is scheduled in the inspected November Board calendar for today.
Omissions and Watch
  • Calendar conflict check: the New York Fed lists Advance International Trade in Goods and Trade balance together Nov 4 at 8:30 AM ET; Census lists U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services for September at that time. The titles do not establish a one-to-one correspondence, so the New York Fed entries are retained separately; Census's differently titled entry is not duplicated. BEA schedules GDP (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits for Nov 25 at 8:30 AM and Personal Income and Outlays for October on Dec 2 at 8:30 AM. The New York Fed separately lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator Nov 25 at 8:30 AM without a period; both listings are retained because they conflict with BEA's published schedule. New York Fed calendar dates/times are tentative and subject to change.
  • The Chicago Fed release calendar lists an NFCI release on Nov 4, but the checked page did not establish an ET time; it is omitted from timed rows. The returned NFCI data file's latest dated row is Oct 23, not Oct 30. No unsupported newer value or release time is inferred. Treasury auctions without verified competitive close times are omitted.
  • Energy schedules: EIA petroleum's standard release is Wednesday at 10:30 AM; its listed Nov 6 data-week exception is Thursday Nov 12 at noon. EIA natural gas is normally Thursday at 10:30 AM, with a listed Veterans Day exception Fri Nov 13 at 10:30 AM. The November calendar includes the standard Nov 4 and Nov 5 releases as well as these exceptions.
  • BLS.gov was not requested; New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendars are cited as BLS release date/time sources. No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item was established in this run; this is not a full risk review. No exchange-specific market-structure or product-hours source was checked. Confirm event changes, liquidity and selected contract details before execution.
  • Sources checked: New York Fed November and December Economic Indicators Calendars; Federal Reserve Board November and December calendars and FOMC calendar; Census 2026 Economic Indicators Calendar; BEA schedule; Chicago Fed release calendar and NFCI file; Philadelphia Fed MBOS calendar; NAR; TreasuryDirect; EIA petroleum and natural gas schedules; New York Fed SOFR; U.S. Treasury daily yield curve; Yahoo Finance charts. Yahoo charts are single-source vendor quotes; futures are generic continuous observations, not official settlements.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
SPY closed Tuesday up 0.30%, while ES=F is 0.53% below Tuesday's completed bar in the early Wednesday quote. The official 10Y close rose 4 bp to 4.95%; MOVE is 99.97 in the moderate-uncertainty band and VIX closed at 20.83. Today's 8:30 AM trade reports, 10:00 AM ISM non-manufacturing and 10:30 AM EIA petroleum report are potential volatility windows; Friday's Employment Situation is High impact. Overnight price discovery remains event-sensitive: seek confirmation from live rates, volatility and liquidity before assessing direction. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES extends lower without confirmation from Treasury yields, volatility or market depth; scheduled data materially reprice rates; or the selected contract's hours/liquidity differ from assumptions. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Verify the contract, event updates and fresh quotes before execution.
